messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: elevated 502/504 rate on apigw-prod (edge). 10m error rate ~9.8% (baseline ~0.2%). Pager: @pager-josh. Link: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/incidents/3498765432

pager-josh: On it — waking up. joining ops channel now. :coffee:

sre-amy: Looking at dashboards. Ingress 5xx spike started ~00:13 UTC. Which upstreams are we seeing errors to? Any deploys in last 30m?

eng-ops: No deploys in last 30m. Nginx error logs show repeated: 
```
2026/03/17 00:14:12 [error] 12345#0: *98765 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.0.1.2, server: _, request: "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.2.5.7:8080/", host: "api.redwood.company"
```

eng-ops: Also seeing connection pool saturated metrics on model-backend-2 (us-west-2) — many connections ESTABLISHED but not returning.

oncall-lead: I'm taking lead for mitigation. @eng-ops please validate if this is upstream (model) or the gateway itself. If upstream, prepare a targeted circuit-break for model-backend-2.

eng-ops: Confirmed upstream. model-backend-2 health shows high latency p95 > 6s and many slow GC spikes. Will circuit-break that pool and shift traffic to model-backend-1/3.

pager-josh: Running quick repro: 
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.company/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```

support-liaison: Customer impact: approx 18% of requests in EU and US-west failing. 4 customers opened P1 tickets (two EU marketplaces, one ad partner). Notifying affected accounts now.

pm-ana: Notifying CS and EPD. Adding known issue note to status page: "Degraded API: 5xx from gateway, mitigation in progress."

eng-ops: Applying circuit-break on route /v1/generate to exclude model-backend-2: 
```yaml
- route: /v1/generate
  upstreams: [model-backend-1, model-backend-3]
  circuit_break: true
```

incident-bot: deploy-bot: manifest applied to apigw-prod (canary rollout 5% -> 100%).

pager-josh: Restarting 3 apigw pods that had high ESTABLISHED conn counts: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/apigw -n prod` executed.

eng-ops: After CB + restart: error rate dropped to ~3.2% in 3 minutes. p95 latency improving. continuing to drain model-backend-2 and collecting core dumps for analysis.

sre-amy: Good. I'm increasing the alert threshold to avoid noise but keeping high-fidelity trace on. Will watch for re-introduction when we re-enable the upstream.

support-liaison: CS updated customers at 00:35 UTC. They're seeing degraded responses but many requests now succeeding.

oncall-lead: Next steps: 1) keep model-backend-2 drained and run memory/GC diagnostics; 2) run a small replay load to validate backend stability; 3) plan rollback of circuit-break only after 30m stable window.

eng-ops: Scheduled diagnostics job and core collection on model-backend-2. Will run replay at 00:55 UTC.

pager-josh: Error rate now 1.1% after 17 minutes. Rolling to Monitoring channel. Will stay as primary until we hit 30m stable.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation in progress — circuit-break + apigw restarts. Current error rate: 1.1%.

pm-ana: Drafting incident summary for postmortem. Support to collect impacted request ids and affected customers for RCA.

sre-amy: Confirmed stable window (30m) started at 00:39 UTC. Will begin reintroducing model-backend-2 with canary 2% at 01:09 UTC once core analysis complete.

eng-ops: Reintroduction plan ready. If error rate creeps above 2% revert to CB.

support-liaison: No new P1s in the last 20m. Existing tickets being updated.

pager-josh: Marking incident as 'mitigated' and handing to follow-up for RCA. I'll remain on watch for another 30m then clear pager. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: apigw 502/504 spike mitigated. Total duration ~56m. Root cause: upstream model-backend-2 memory/GC causing connection drops. Postmortem assigned to eng-ml + eng-ops. Link: https://incidents.internal.redwood/3498765432/postmortem
